deck.title: Демо: изрази на ниво C1
deck.description: 30 проверени карти — фразови глаголи, идиоми и колокации, които често се срещат в Use of English. Значенията са сверени с Cambridge Dictionary; примерите са оригинални.

items.text: New research has {{c1::shed}} light on how the brain stores memories during sleep.
items.context: Идиом: изяснявам нещо, хвърлям светлина върху него.
items.explanation: Устойчив израз: shed light on something — давам информация, която прави нещо по-разбираемо. Глаголът shed е неправилен: shed – shed – shed.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: shed light on sth (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to slowly accept a sad or difficult situation
items.example: It took him years to come to terms with the loss of his job.
items.hint: примирявам се с нещо, приемам нещо тежко
items.explanation: Идиом. След него идва съществително: come to terms with a loss, with a decision, with the past.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: come to terms with something (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to consider something when you judge a situation or make a decision
items.example: The final grade takes into account both coursework and exam results.
items.explanation: Когато обектът е дълъг, той застава след „into account“: take into account the fact that… Същото значение има take account of something.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: take something into account (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to remember a fact when you make a decision or think about something
items.example: Bear in mind that the museum closes early on Sundays.
items.explanation: Често с „that“: bear in mind that… Вариант със същото значение: keep something in mind.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: bear/keep something in mind (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.text: With prices rising so fast, many families are struggling to make {{c1::ends}} meet.
items.context: Идиом: свързвам двата края — имам точно толкова пари, колкото ми трябват.
items.explanation: Устойчив израз: make ends meet. Съществителното е в множествено число — ends.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: make ends meet (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: in general; when you consider everything together
items.example: By and large, the new timetable has worked well.
items.explanation: Израз със значение на наречие, обикновено в началото на изречението. Синоним: on the whole.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: by and large (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.text: After months of failed talks, the two companies are on the {{c1::verge}} of an agreement.
items.context: Идиом: съвсем близо до нещо, на прага му.
items.explanation: Устойчив израз: on the verge of something. Със същото значение е on the brink of something.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: on the verge (of) (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.text: Safety rules were tightened in the {{c1::wake}} of last year's accident.
items.context: Идиом: след нещо и често вследствие на него.
items.explanation: Устойчив израз: in the wake of something — след събитие и често заради него. Типичен за новини и доклади.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: in the wake of something (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to make something seem less important or less bad than it really is
items.example: The minister tried to play down the importance of the leaked report.
items.explanation: Фразов глагол. Обектът може да е между двете части или след тях: play the problem down / play down the problem.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: play something down (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to suggest an idea, a plan or a person for other people to consider
items.example: Several solutions were put forward at the meeting, but none was accepted.
items.explanation: Фразов глагол за идеи, мнения, планове и кандидати: put forward a proposal, an argument, a candidate.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: put something/someone forward (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to decide or say that something is impossible or will not happen, or that it is not suitable
items.example: The police have not ruled out the possibility of arson.
items.explanation: Често с „the possibility“: rule out the possibility of something.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: rule something or someone out (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to be very easy to notice; to be much better than similar things or people
items.example: Her essay stood out because of its original argument.
items.explanation: Фразов глагол без обект. Когато се сравнява: stand out from the rest.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: stand out (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to think of an idea or a plan; to find or produce something that is needed
items.example: We need to come up with a better plan before Friday.
items.explanation: Фразов глагол от три части. Обектът е винаги накрая: come up with an idea, a solution, the money.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: come up with something (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to do or complete a task, especially one that you promised or were told to do
items.example: The school carried out a survey of students' reading habits.
items.explanation: Съчетава се с research, tests, a survey, an experiment, orders, a threat.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: carry something out (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to do what is necessary to stay level or equal with someone or something
items.example: It's hard to keep up with all the changes in technology.
items.hint: не изоставам от, поддържам темпото на
items.explanation: С предлога „with“, когато се казва с кого или с какво: keep up with demand, with inflation, with the news.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: keep up (with someone/something) (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to be as good as people expected
items.example: Sadly, the sequel didn't live up to our expectations.
items.explanation: Колокация: live up to expectations или live up to someone's expectations. Често в отрицание: didn't live up to…
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: live up to someone's expectations (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to examine the facts about a problem or situation
items.example: The company promised to look into my complaint.
items.explanation: Фразов глагол със значение „проучвам“. Синоним: investigate.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: look into something (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to make people understand or believe something
items.example: The poster gets the message across in just a few words.
items.explanation: Често: get your point across или get a message across (to someone).
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: get something across (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to make something happen
items.example: The internet has brought about huge changes in the way we learn.
items.explanation: Синоними: cause, lead to, result in.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: bring something about (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to form a part or the total of something
items.example: Tourism accounts for almost a fifth of the country's income.
items.explanation: Официален израз, чест в доклади и статистики: X accounts for 20 % of… Има и друго значение — обяснявам причината за нещо.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: account for something (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.text: With the championship title at {{c1::stake}}, neither team could afford a single mistake.
items.context: Идиом: заложено на карта, може да бъде загубено.
items.explanation: Устойчив израз: be at stake — нещо ценно може да бъде загубено. Не се бърка със steak (пържола).
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: at stake (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to not realise or show how grateful you should be for something or someone, because you are used to having them
items.example: We often take clean water for granted until it is cut off.
items.explanation: Има и второ значение — приемам нещо за истина, без да се замисля: I took it for granted that…
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: take something for granted (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: to make it possible or easier for something or someone to follow
items.example: The discovery paved the way for new cancer treatments.
items.explanation: Идиом: pave the way for something/someone. Глаголът е правилен: paved.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: pave the way (for something/someone) (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.text: The builders were accused of cutting {{c1::corners}} to finish the bridge ahead of schedule.
items.context: Идиом: работя през пръсти, за да спестя време или пари.
items.explanation: Устойчив израз: cut corners — спестявам време или пари, като пропускам части от работата, и резултатът е по-лош. Изразява неодобрение.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: cut corners (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.text: Rising sea levels {{c1::pose}} a serious threat to coastal towns.
items.explanation: С глагола pose се съчетават threat, risk, problem и challenge: pose a threat to someone or something.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: pose (verb, cause) (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.text: The inspectors are determined to get to the {{c1::bottom}} of what caused the power cut.
items.context: Идиом: откривам истинската причина за нещо.
items.explanation: Устойчив израз: get to the bottom of something — откривам истината за дадена ситуация.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: get to the bottom of something (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.text: Good teachers manage to {{c1::strike}} a balance between discipline and encouragement.
items.context: Идиом: намирам разумен баланс между две неща.
items.explanation: Устойчив израз: strike a balance between A and B. Глаголът е strike (минало време: struck).
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: strike a balance (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.back: at a time far away in the future; eventually
items.example: Learning to cook will save you money in the long run.
items.hint: в дългосрочен план, в крайна сметка
items.explanation: Идиом със значение на наречие, обикновено в края на изречението.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: in the long run (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.text: Life in the capital was a far {{c1::cry}} from the quiet village where she grew up.
items.explanation: Устойчив израз: be a far cry from something — напълно различно е от нещо.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: be a far cry from something (проверено на 25.09.2026)

items.front: make a point of doing something
items.back: to always do something, or to take particular care to do it
items.example: She makes a point of reading a newspaper every morning.
items.hint: държа да правя нещо, правя го нарочно
items.explanation: След израза идва -ing форма: make a point of doing something.
items.source: Cambridge Dictionary: make a point of doing something (проверено на 25.09.2026)
